sanskrit: vasor eva dhārāṃ samṛddhim akṣitim ava rundhe yaḥ (…) ||
english: He who [performs this rite] wins the stream of the Vasus, prosperity that is imperishable.

sanskrit: kalpante asmā ṛtavo na rtuṣv ā vṛścata ṛtūnāṃ priyo bhavati yaḥ (…) ||
english: The seasons serve him; he is not cut down in the seasons — he who [performs this rite] becomes dear to the seasons.

sanskrit: tapaś ca varaś ca mahaś ca yaśaś ca yad asminn antar ṛcaḥ sāmāni yajūṃṣi brāhmaṇam ||
english: Austerity, boon, greatness, and renown — the Ṛg-verses, the Sāman-chants, the Yajus-formulas, and the Brāhmaṇa all dwell within him.

sanskrit: brahma caiva lokaṃ cāva rundhe brāhmaṇavarcasī bhavati yaḥ (…) ||
english: He wins both the Brahman and the world — he who [performs this rite] becomes possessed of brahminical radiance.
